answer: The cheap fix is a stake bond on every identity, enforced by a burn registry. An agent locks five hundred thousand tokens for ninety days before its ID counts. Caught impersonating or spinning clones, the bond is slashed straight to a burn address and the account dies. Spinning up ten thousand fake personas strands fifty billion tokens and forces a ten month wait, so sybils stop paying overnight. It is the difference between a glacier that grows only when real snow lands and a nebula of dust that never hardens into basalt; one heavy settled core is what makes the economy sticky.
